q: 1. The filler used in plastic bitumen, is ............
explain: Asbestos powder is used as a filler in bitumen to improve its temperature resistance and binding properties for certain industrial applications.

q: 2. The age of tree can be known by ............
explain: In temperate climates, a tree adds one growth ring (annular ring) each year. Counting these rings provides an estimate of the tree's age.

q: 3. Plastic bitumen is generally used for
explain: Plastic bitumen (bitumen mixed with fillers like asbestos or limestone) is thick and sticky, making it perfect for filling cracks in masonry or concrete.

q: 4. Asphalt is obtained from
explain: Asphalt is a natural or manufactured product obtained as a residue from the fractional distillation of crude petroleum.

q: 5. Mastic asphalt is normally used for
explain: Due to its voidless and impermeable nature, mastic asphalt is an excellent material for damp-proofing and waterproofing of roofs and basements.

q: 6. Mastic asphalt is
explain: Mastic asphalt is inherently non-corrosive and durable, resisting atmospheric agents effectively over long periods.

q: 7. Consolidation of concrete should proceed
explain: Consolidation (vibration or tamping) must be done immediately after placing the concrete in the forms to remove entrapped air and ensure density.

q: 8. The steel used for rails under heavy traffic and on sharp curves is
explain: Manganese steel is extremely tough and wear-resistant, making it ideal for railway tracks that face heavy impact and abrasion.

q: 9. Bitumen felt is used for
explain: Bitumen felts are flexible sheets used for both vertical damp-proofing in walls and horizontal waterproofing on roofs.

q: 10. Bituminous felts are used for ...............
explain: Bituminous felt is a common waterproofing material used as an underlay or outer covering for A.C. sheets to prevent water ingress.

q: 11. Mastic asphalt is generally used for ...............
explain: Due to its impervious nature, mastic asphalt is ideal for DPC in foundations and as a waterproofing membrane on flat roofs.

q: 12. According to I.S.I. bitumen is classified into ...............
explain: Indian Standard (ISI) traditionally classified paving bitumen into 10 grades based on penetration values (e.g., 30/40, 80/100).

q: 13. Bitumen is generally obtained from ...............
explain: Bitumen is a residual product obtained during the fractional distillation of crude petroleum.

q: 14. Bitumen may be dissolved in ...............
explain: Bitumen is defined as a mixture of hydrocarbons that are completely soluble in carbon disulphide (CS2).

q: 15. Plastic asphalt is ...............
options: used as a water proofing layer over roof
a mixture of cement and asphalt
explain: Plastic asphalt is a highly viscous bitumen mixture of Cement and Asphalt.

q: 16. Vanadium steel is generally used for .............
explain: Vanadium steel is known for its high tensile strength and fatigue resistance, making it ideal for components subjected to heavy vibrations like axles and springs.

q: 17. The wood generally used for railway sleepers is .............
explain: Kail is a softwood that is naturally durable and resistant to decay, making it highly suitable for outdoor use as railway sleepers.

q: 18. The concrete mix used for general R.C.C. work is .............
explain: 1:2:4 (M15 grade) is a standard nominal mix used for general reinforced cement concrete (R.C.C.) works in small buildings.

q: 19. Which of the following trees yields hard wood?
explain: Shisham is an angiosperm (deciduous tree) which yields hardwood. Deodar, Chir, and Pine are conifers which yield softwood.

q: 20. When a bitumen is graded 75/15, the figure 75 represents ............
explain: In the grading of industrial bitumen (like 75/15), the first number denotes the softening point in degrees Celsius, and the second number represents the penetration value.

q: 21. For the manufacture of plywood, veneers are placed so that grains of adjacent veneers ............
explain: Placing grains at 90 degrees to each other reduces shrinkage and prevents splitting along the grain, providing cross-grain strength.

q: 22. Bitumen paints offer ............
explain: Bituminous paints are primarily used for their waterproof and alkali-resistant properties, providing a protective layer for iron work and submerged structures.

q: 23. Teak wood is suitable for ............
explain: Teak is a versatile, high-quality timber used for everything from fine furniture .

q: 24. Veneering means ............
options: carving out designs on timber planks
thick layer of superior wood glued to inferior wood
thin layer of superior wood glued to inferior wood
explain: Veneering involves gluing very thin slices of high-quality wood (veneers) onto the surface of cheaper wood or particle board.
